subject: reference-alfil

arrangement.label: typographic-with-marginal-aside
arrangement.notes: Large serif headline plus a bordered marginal note; no image in the hero itself. Closest known value would be typographic-only, but the bordered aside column makes it not purely typographic.

aspectTendency.label: text-only-no-box
aspectTendency.notes: Primary action is an underlined text link with no button chrome at all. A separate secondary action IS a sharp outline rectangle. This dimension assumes one dominant CTA language per page — Alfil deliberately has two (see freeformNotes).

character.label: underline-grow-and-indent
character.notes: Animated underline reveal on the text-link CTA; list rows indent slightly on hover. No entrance fade, scale, parallax, or stagger.

freeformNotes: Two coexisting CTA languages (text-link primary, outline-rectangle secondary) don't fit cleanly into a single 'cta' descriptor — flagged as a StyleFingerprintV0 limitation, not resolved here. Media placeholder is a flat gradient block, explicitly labeled 'Foto de muestra' — media.dominantType/treatment left 'unknown', not 'photography'.
